deadline.value: International applicants: March 1, 2027, including reference letters and transcripts. Applications are reviewed first-come, first-served with rolling offers, so applying early helps. (Domestic: up to August 30/31.)
deadline.quote: International Students: March 1, 2027, including the receipt of reference letters and transcripts. | Applications to our programs are vetted first-come, first-served, and admission offers are sent out on a rolling basis

app_fee.value: CAD 185, non-refundable (SGPS standard fee; may differ for some programs). Physics & Astronomy refunds the fee to admitted students who accept and enrol, after their first month.
app_fee.quote: $185 CAD Non-refundable | The application fee amount may be different for certain graduate programs.

also.quote: Students who are admitted to the Physics and Astronomy Graduate Program and accept our Admission Offer will be refunded their application fee at the end of their first month in the program.

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.quote: Applicants to our program are not required to take the Graduate Record Exam (GRE).

gre_physics.value: International applicants (and those with offshore or engineering degrees) are strongly urged to take the Physics GRE; upper-third scores are a decided advantage
gre_physics.quote: However, International students and domestic students with degrees from offshore Universities or Engineering degrees are strongly urged to write the GRE-Physics examination. | Students who receive a mark with a rank in the upper third of those sitting the exam will be at a decided advantage

toefl_min.value: Department minimum TOEFL iBT 90 with no section below 22 (higher than the SGPS minimum of 86); IELTS 7; Duolingo 130
toefl_min.quote: The minimum acceptable score is 90, with no individual score below 22 for the internet-based version | The minimum acceptable overall score is 7 out of 9. | The minimum acceptable score is 130.

english_waiver.value: Automatic exemption only if English is your first language, or after 2+ full-time years at an English-speaking institution in a listed country whose primary language is English. India is not on the list.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants are automatically exempted from our English language proficiency requirement if either: | They have completed at least two full-time years of post-secondary education in a degree program in an English-speaking institution located in a country whose primary language is English. | The list of eligible countries is as follows:

supervisor.value: Every admission offer is made together with the student's faculty supervisor; contacting potential supervisors before applying is strongly encouraged
supervisor.quote: All admission offers to our Department are made in conjunction with the student's faculty supervisor. Interested students are strongly encouraged to contact potential supervisors in advance of their application.

funding.value: All MSc and PhD students receive a funding package covering living expenses and tuition (scholarship, fellowship and TA); no minimum amount is stated on the page (2026-27 stipend examples are in a linked PDF)
funding.quote: All MSc and PhD graduate students are provided with competitive funding support packages for both living expenses and tuition costs.

entry_route.value: PhD applicants must have completed an MSc (or equivalent) in physics, astronomy or engineering with at least a 70% (B) average
entry_route.quote: Applicants for our PhD programs must have completed an MSc degree (or equivalent) in either Physics, Astronomy or Engineering with at least a 70% (or B) average taken over all MSc graduate courses.

notes: Exemption country list (SGPS) does not include India. Application fee is refunded to admitted students who enrol in Physics & Astronomy. Department TOEFL/IELTS minimums exceed SGPS minimums.
